items.title: Make capability probes and intake obey the canonical secrets gateway
items.premise: Session 60 repaired check-secrets, but probe-capability and paste-credential still hard-code this public repo's absent secrets/CAPABILITY_MAP.json. The live cloudflare.dns probe therefore prints an empty array and an honest skip despite canonical readiness; the probe also attempts to write private operational receipts under public portfolio/ and to stamp whichever map it reads.
evidence: node scripts/probe-capability.mjs --for cloudflare.dns --json exits 0 with [] and SKIPPED=no-capability-map
probe-capability imports resolveCapability/getSecret but independently hard-codes CAP_MAP_PATH and portfolio/ops ledger
paste-credential independently hard-codes project-local secrets and reports no canonical capabilities
scripts/lib/secrets.mjs already owns local-override/canonical-fallback capability authority and status-only redaction

L1.recipe: Expose a read-only capability-map snapshot/path contract from secrets.mjs and consume it in probe-capability.

L2.recipe: Create explicit secrets-gateway authority exports, make probes and intake list/parse use them, keep probe receipts in ignored project cache, never mutate a canonical sibling map during a read-only probe, retain deliberate canonical intake writes only when the founder invokes intake, add isolated local/canonical/no-map tests, and rerun a real status-only cloudflare.dns token verification.

L3.recipe: Add a versioned redacted operation receipt that binds capability definition source, credential-source classes, probe endpoint, and write authority without exposing paths or values.

verification: cloudflare.dns no longer phantom-skips when canonical definitions exist
read-only probes cannot alter sibling CAPABILITY_MAP.json
public tracked paths never receive capability probe ledgers or secret material
local override, canonical fallback, missing map, and corrupt map remain distinguishable
no raw credential value reaches stdout or tests
implementationEvidence: Canonical/local/corrupt authority fixtures pass 6/6 with no raw values.
Live cloudflare.dns status-only token verification returns HTTP 200 from canonical definition authority.
Read-only probe receipts are redacted and cache-only; no capability map is stamped.

items.title: Make the Pages artifact carry a self-validating edge-security policy
items.premise: The canonical origin exposes nosniff and referrer policy only; HSTS, frame protection, and CSP remain absent. The source artifact has no _headers or security.txt contract, so even an authorized owning-host ingest lacks a project-authored policy to apply. A local artifact can close that source gap without pretending the current Cloudflare host applied it.
evidence: live launch evidence reports /_health HTTP 404 and all three required edge-security booleans false
public contains health, identity, legal, agent, and sitemap files but no _headers or .well-known/security.txt
the only inline script blocks are JSON-LD in index and landing; their exact hashes can be generated
style attributes require an explicit style-src policy while script execution can remain hash-bound

L1.recipe: Add public security.txt and a documented header policy template.

L2.recipe: Generate an artifact _headers policy from exact inline-script hashes during build, include HSTS, CSP, frame, MIME, referrer, permissions, base/object/form, and upgrade contracts, emit security.txt and a machine-readable policy receipt to every supported mount, fail the build on an unhashed inline script or unsafe source, and extend static smoke plus release fixtures while keeping live origin status red until external application is observed.

L3.recipe: Add a hosted header-attestation receipt that joins policy fingerprint, deployed revision, health receipt, and live headers and produces an Ark-ready owning-host application payload.

verification: every inline script hash in built HTML is represented in CSP
all supported mounts contain identical policy/security receipts
static smoke rejects policy drift or unsafe inline execution
local artifact security can be green while external launch remains honestly HOLD
no production-host application is claimed without a live response header
implementationEvidence: Pages build emits hash-bound _headers, security.txt, and edge-policy-receipt.json to every declared mount.
Exact inline script and style-element hashes are in Content Security Policy; unsafe executable sources fail the build.
Static smoke passes while live attestation truthfully remains HOLD on missing hosted HSTS/CSP/frame/permissions headers and revision binding.

The source artifact has no _headers or security.txt contract, so even an authorized owning-host ingest lacks a project-authored policy to apply. A local artifact can close that source gap without pretending the current Cloudflare host applied it.
items.recipe: Generate an artifact _headers policy from exact inline-script hashes during build, include HSTS, CSP, frame, MIME, referrer, permissions, base/object/form, and upgrade contracts, emit security.txt and a machine-readable policy receipt to every supported mount, fail the build on an unhashed inline script or unsafe source, and extend static smoke plus release fixtures while keeping live origin status red until external application is observed.

items.title: Prove transport-neutral API authority on the Architect endpoint family
items.premise: Server and static adapters independently assemble GET/POST /api/architect-thesis responses. The fresh endpoint already differs in its state projection function, and the new review fields would double the drift surface unless one transport-neutral handler owns status and payload semantics.
evidence: src/server.js and src/app/api/localApiRuntime.js contain parallel Architect GET/POST branches
both call the same GameSession methods but independently choose response status and success payload
apiContract checks required fields but cannot prove both adapters assembled identical semantic payloads
the previous audit explicitly deferred full router consolidation until an incremental endpoint-family seam existed

L1.recipe: Extract one pure response projection used by both branches.

L2.recipe: Create a dependency-free Architect handler kernel that accepts session and state projection capabilities, owns GET/POST status and body semantics including 400/404/409, wire both adapters through it, declare the family in the executable contract, and add semantic parity fixtures for success, validation, stale revision, and review fields.

L3.recipe: Generalize a manifest-driven handler-family registry and migrate the adjacent GM Legacy and rivalry read families under exact parity metrics.

verification: no adapter independently assembles an Architect response
server and static runtimes return equal status and semantic body for the same session/input
stale revisions remain fail-closed 409
review fields cannot exist in one runtime only
bidirectional route and response-shape authority remains green

Success, validation, missing-session, and stale-revision response authority is transport-neutral.

items.title: Extract trade evaluation and commit into one characterized transaction service
items.premise: GameSession remains a 5,406-line god object. Its 200-plus-line evaluateTradePackage and tradePlayers block owns asset validation, challenge restrictions, cap checks, AI valuation, mutation, news, logging, depth, ratings, stat, and lookup refresh in one class; the existing transaction module is only a facade back into those methods.
evidence: GameSession spans 5,406 measured source lines and more than 100 public methods
ContractService currently owns only exact cap summary authority and establishes the safe delegated-service pattern
createSessionModules.transactions forwards directly to GameSession instead of a transaction service
trade code has focused API/runtime coverage that can characterize response and mutation parity

L1.recipe: Create TradeService as a facade without moving authority.

L2.recipe: Extract shared transaction-strategy helpers and the complete evaluate/commit transaction into TradeService, keep thin backward-compatible GameSession delegators, expose the service through the module bundle, enforce clone-free atomic refusal semantics, and add characterization fixtures for invalid assets, challenge restrictions, cap failure, valuation failure, player/pick mutation, logs, news, and all derived-index refreshes.

L3.recipe: Add an immutable staged TradePlan receipt with expected authority revision and commit-time revalidation so stale trade previews cannot mutate newer rosters.

verification: GameSession trade methods are thin delegators
service refusal paths mutate nothing
successful player and pick moves preserve existing response shape and every derived refresh
transaction module calls the service authority directly
existing API/browser trade flows remain unchanged
focused runtime, transaction, API parity, and full shards pass
implementationEvidence: Trade evaluation and commit moved from GameSession into characterized TradeService; GameSession retains two thin delegators.
